english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function such that $f(x+1)=-f(x)$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}$ and $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\,dx=2$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{20}x\,f(x)\,dx$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ एक सतत फलन है जिसके लिए सभी $x\in\mathbb{R}$ के लिए $f(x+1)=-f(x)$ तथा $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{1}f(x)\,dx=2$ है। तब $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{20}x\,f(x)\,dx$ का मान ______ है।
solution_full: Applying the condition twice, $f(x+2)=-f(x+1)=f(x)$, so $f$ is periodic with period $2$; also $\int_1^{2}f=\int_0^1f(t+1)dt=-\int_0^1f=-2$, so $\int_0^{2}f=0$.

Split $[0,20]$ into the ten periods $[2m,2m+2]$, $m=0,\dots,9$. With $x=t+2m$ and $f(t+2m)=f(t)$: $\int_{2m}^{2m+2}xf(x)\,dx=\int_0^{2}(t+2m)f(t)\,dt=\int_0^{2}tf(t)\,dt+2m\int_0^{2}f(t)\,dt=\int_0^{2}tf(t)\,dt$.
Hence $\int_0^{20}xf(x)\,dx=10\times(-2)=-20$. (Example: $f(x)=\pi\sin\pi x$ satisfies the conditions and gives $-20$.)
originality_note: New: an anti-periodic function (f(x+1) = -f(x)) with only int_0^1 f known, so the weighted integral must be computed without knowing f, the unknown moment cancelling (way 4). Closest known: int_0^{nT} f = n int_0^T f for periodic f. Different because: the weight x is not periodic, and the answer depends only on int_0^1 f after a cancellation.

concept_use.Property for periodic functions: f(x+1) = -f(x) makes f periodic with period 2 and int over a period 0; the x-weight is shifted period by period, and the unknown int_0^1 t f(t) dt cancels.

stem_review: Read as a student: f continuous with domain/codomain; condition for all x; the answer is independent of the unknown int_0^1 t f(t) dt (checked with f = pi sin(pi x): -20). Answer -20, a negative integer as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: f has period 2 with zero mean; each period contributes int_0^2 t f(t) dt = -int_0^1 f = -2.
justification: Routine chain of periodic-function properties with one cancellation. Same demand as 2024-P2-Q16 (L2).
